projects.label: Work
projects.title: Six projects, measured and written up
projects.lede: Every major project has its own case study: the problem, the technical choices, the numbers, and what did not work.

items.name: PFEE — BNF
items.title: Segmentation & classification of heritage illustrations
items.tagline: Automatic detection of illustrations in digitized heritage documents, in partnership with the BNF.

items.name: ALPR
items.title: Automatic license plate recognition
items.tagline: Complete ALPR system without deep learning (classical vision + machine learning), with rigorous Python vs C++ benchmarks.

items.name: IRGPU
items.title: Real-time video motion detection — GPU port
items.tagline: CPU → GPU port of a real-time algorithm achieving a ×24 performance gain via CUDA.

items.name: MedViz
items.title: Medical prediction & 3D visualization
items.tagline: Full FVC prediction pipeline from pulmonary CT scans, with 3D visualization in the browser.

items.name: POGL
items.title: Real-time fluid simulation
items.tagline: Real-time 3D SPH engine, 75,000 particles at 60 FPS — GPU physics via compute shaders and SSFR surface rendering.

items.name: VTK-ITK
items.title: Brain tumor registration & longitudinal tracking
items.tagline: 3D MRI alignment (ITK) with tumor segmentation and interactive multi-view visualization (VTK + PyQt6) — quantifying the evolution of a glioma.

items.name: gitlab-to-github
items.title: Repository migration CLI
items.tagline: Migrates GitLab repositories to GitHub — including code, wikis, issues and merge requests.

items.name: 3D L-System
items.title: Procedural 3D plant generator
items.tagline: L-system plant generation with real-time editing of rewriting rules through Dear ImGui.

items.name: TinyX
items.title: Clone of the social network X
items.tagline: X-style social platform built by a team of 14, microservices architecture and rigorous DevOps.
items.repoNote: Public repository: front end only. The microservices back end lives on a private EPITA GitLab.

items.name: Tiger
items.title: Full compiler construction
items.tagline: A compiler for the Tiger language, from lexical analysis to type checking.

items.name: OCR Sudoku
items.title: Digit recognition & Sudoku solver
items.tagline: Grid detection, OCR via a CNN trained from scratch, and automatic solving.
